name: Belgian Legal Documents (FR)
description: Belgian legal documents in French (citations, conclusions, actes, contrats, devis, courriers). Detects the national register number (NN / NISS / BIS: 85.07.30-033.00 anywhere, 85073003300 after its label), the BCE / TVA company number in every form (0123.456.789, BE0123456789, 10 digits after BCE, TVA or n° d'entreprise), Belgian phone numbers and foreign ones written with +, cadastral references, Belgian street addresses and postal codes, company names by legal form (SRL, SA, ASBL…), IBAN, plus personal names. Amounts in €, dates, article references and roll numbers (RG) stay visible on purpose.

patterns.name: NN
patterns.description: National register number (numéro de registre national, NISS, INSZ) and BIS number: 85.07.30-033.00, 85 07 30 033 00, 850730-033-00 anywhere; 85073003300 after a label (NN, N.N., n° national, registre national, RN, NISS, INSZ, numéro BIS, rijksregisternummer).

patterns.name: Numéro BCE / TVA
patterns.description: Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises / KBO number: 0123.456.789 or 1042.891.837 anywhere, BE0123456789 or BE 0123.456.789 (TVA / BTW), 10 digits after BCE, KBO, TVA, BTW, RPM or n° d'entreprise.

patterns.name: Téléphone
patterns.description: Belgian phone numbers: 02 123 45 67, 010/45.67.89, 0475 12 34 56, +32 (0)2 123 45 67, +32 475 12 34 56, plus foreign numbers written with +.

patterns.name: Cadastre
patterns.description: Cadastral reference: division, section, parcelle or n° together with its number or letter.

patterns.name: Adresse
patterns.description: Belgian or French street address: street type + name + house number (12A, 12 bis, 135/2, bte 4).

patterns.name: Code postal
patterns.description: Belgian 4-digit postal code followed by city name

patterns.name: Société
patterns.description: Company name followed by a Belgian legal form (SRL, SA, ASBL, NV…)

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.
